name: Strategy / Management
description: A simulation the player steers from above. The interface is usually the biggest pillar, since the player reads the game through it.

pillars.name: Simulation
pillars.description: The rules that run the world underneath the player.

pillars.name: Resources
pillars.description: What exists to be gathered, stored and spent.

pillars.name: Production Chains
pillars.description: How resources turn into other resources.

pillars.name: Time and Tick
pillars.description: Simulation speed, pausing and keeping it deterministic and fast.

pillars.name: Units and Agents
pillars.description: The things that act in the world.

pillars.name: Agent AI
pillars.description: How units decide what to do.

pillars.name: Pathfinding
pillars.description: How units move across the map at scale.

pillars.name: Economy and Balancing
pillars.description: Costs, rates and tuning that keep choices meaningful.

pillars.name: Camera and Controls
pillars.description: How the player views the map and selects and commands things.

pillars.name: Map Generation
pillars.description: Hand-made or generated maps, terrain and resource placement.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.description: Information-dense panels, overlays, tooltips and notifications: the player's main window into the simulation.

pillars.name: Overlays
pillars.description: Map overlays that visualize simulation data.

pillars.name: Panels and Tooltips
pillars.description: Detail views, tooltips and how deep information goes.

pillars.name: Notifications
pillars.description: Alerts that pull the player's attention to what matters.
